data.title: Early Childhood Education Teacher, Eestinkallio Preschool
data.summary: The teacher plans, implements and evaluates preschool pedagogy with the team and shares team leadership. The role also involves close cooperation with families.

requirements.text: Bachelor's in education with ECE training, or an accepted equivalent
Criminal record extract required for work with children
Ability to meet children and parents individually, respectfully and sensitively
requirements.question: What does 'meeting children and parents individually, respectfully and sensitively' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting values an individual, respectful and sensitive approach to children and their parents.
